technique_name: Describe the political situation in France.
description: France is a unitary semi-presidential republic with its main democratic institutions in place since the French Revolution. Its current president is Emmanuel Macron and its prime minister is Jean Castex. The French legislative branch is bicameral, with the National Assembly and the Senate making up the legislature.
